example.title: Felixstowe reefer import checklist
example.html:
Summary
Felixstowe reefer import checklist: Harbour Agency checks each reefer's commodity code against the invoice and packing list before the vessel arrives. In use since 12 Oct 2026; Oliver Wright tracks arrivals. Next: Tom Hendriks' customs team to check codes on all UK-bound reefers before submission.

How the check works
1. Booking confirmed: customs coordinator sends invoice and packing list to Harbour.
2. At least 2 working days before vessel ETA: Harbour checks the code against the goods description.
3. Mismatch: Harbour calls Marta Kowalska; code corrected with supplier before arrival.
4. Import declaration lodged and accepted before arrival.
5. Arrival day: Oliver Wright confirms release status.

Decisions
Marta Kowalska drafted v1. Harbour agreed 9 Oct, provided documents arrive at booking; otherwise it says so at once. The 22–25 Sep hold was our wrong code, not Veltrans' (Tom Hendriks, 14 Oct). Demurrage EUR 1,260.00 stays with Corp Europe (Mark de Boer, 21 Oct).
